declarations.type:
∀ (left right : ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.RouteCost),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.StrictlyDominates left right →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.NoWorse right left → False

declarations.type:
∀ (left right : ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.RouteCost),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.CostEquivalent left right →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.StrictlyDominates left right ∧
      ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.StrictlyDominates right left
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.cost_equivalence_excludes_strict_dominance

declarations.type:
∀ (Frontier : ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.FrontierEntry → Prop)
  (candidate : ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.FrontierEntry),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.StrictFrontierAntichain Frontier →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.CandidateUndominated Frontier candidate →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.CandidateFresh Frontier candidate →
        ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.StrictFrontierAntichain
          (ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.InsertedFrontier Frontier candidate)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.undominated_fresh_insertion_preserves_strict_antichain

declarations.type:
∀ (Frontier Candidates : ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.FrontierEntry → Prop)
  (candidate : ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.FrontierEntry),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.EntryParetoCovers Frontier Candidates →
    (∀ (existing : ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.FrontierEntry),
        Frontier existing →
          ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.StrictlyDominates candidate.cost existing.cost ∨
            ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.StrictlyDominates candidate.cost existing.cost) →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.EntryParetoCovers
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.InsertedFrontier Frontier candidate)
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.CandidatesAfterInsert Candidates candidate)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.insertion_preserves_pareto_coverage

declarations.type:
∀ (Frontier : ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.FrontierEntry → Prop)
  (existing candidate : ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.FrontierEntry),
  Frontier existing →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.CostEquivalent existing.cost candidate.cost →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.InsertedFrontier Frontier candidate candidate ∧
        ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.InsertedFrontier Frontier candidate existing
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.equal_cost_distinct_provenance_routes_survive_insertion
ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.equal_cost_routes_can_have_distinct_canonical_identity

declarations.type:
have cheaper :=
  { canonicalRouteIdentity := 7, evidenceProvenanceDigest := 70,
    cost :=
      { graphHops := 1, interactionRounds := 0, projectedTokens := 0, verificationOps := 0, searchExecutions := 0,
        modelPrefixRecomputations := 0 } };
have drifted :=
  { canonicalRouteIdentity := 7, evidenceProvenanceDigest := 71,
    cost :=
      { graphHops := 2, interactionRounds := 0, projectedTokens := 0, verificationOps := 0, searchExecutions := 0,
        modelPrefixRecomputations := 0 } };
ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.SameCanonicalRoute cheaper drifted ∧
  ASPProof.SearchRouteGraphRouterParetoCostSelection.StrictlyDominates cheaper.cost drifted.cost
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.canonical_identity_alone_can_hide_cost_drift

declarations.type:
∀ (fixedBytes candidateBytes removalCount frontierCapacity removalReceiptByteMaximum : Nat),
  removalCount ≤ frontierCapacity →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.ExplicitDecisionDeltaBytes fixedBytes candidateBytes
        removalCount removalReceiptByteMaximum ≤
      ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.ExplicitDecisionDeltaBytes fixedBytes candidateBytes
        frontierCapacity removalReceiptByteMaximum
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.explicit_delta_is_bounded_by_frontier_capacity

declarations.type:
∀ (fixedBytes candidateBytes firstRemovalCount secondRemovalCount removalSummaryBytes : Nat),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.SummarizedDecisionDeltaBytes fixedBytes candidateBytes
      firstRemovalCount removalSummaryBytes =
    ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.SummarizedDecisionDeltaBytes fixedBytes candidateBytes
      secondRemovalCount removalSummaryBytes
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteIncrementalParetoFrontierProvenanceDelta.summarized_delta_is_independent_of_removal_count
